segments.template: {{ $j := list }}{{ with .Env.OMP_JOBS_RUNNING }}{{ if ne . "0" }}{{ $j = append $j (printf "%s&" .) }}{{ end }}{{ end }}{{ with .Env.OMP_JOBS_STOPPED }}{{ if ne . "0" }}{{ $j = append $j (printf "%sz" .) }}{{ end }}{{ end }}{{ if $j }}{{ join "/" $j }} {{ end }}

{{ $v := "" }}{{ if .Env.VIRTUAL_ENV }}{{ $v = trimAll "() " .Env.VIRTUAL_ENV_PROMPT }}{{ if not $v }}{{ $v = base .Env.VIRTUAL_ENV }}{{ end }}{{ else if .Env.CONDA_DEFAULT_ENV }}{{ $v = base .Env.CONDA_DEFAULT_ENV }}{{ end }}{{ if $v }}[{{ $v }}] {{ end }}

{{ .HEAD }}{{ $u := 0 }}{{ if or .Merge .Rebase (gt (add .Working.Unmerged .Staging.Unmerged) 0) }}{{ with cmd "git" "--no-optional-locks" "diff" "--name-only" "--diff-filter=U" "-z" "--" }}{{ $u = sub (len (splitList "\x00" .)) 1 }}{{ end }}{{ end }}{{ $m := add .Working.Modified .Staging.Modified }}{{ $a := add .Working.Added .Staging.Added }}{{ $d := add .Working.Deleted .Staging.Deleted }}{{ $f := list }}{{ if gt $m 0 }}{{ $f = append $f (printf "~%d" $m) }}{{ end }}{{ if gt $a 0 }}{{ $f = append $f (printf "+%d" $a) }}{{ end }}{{ if gt $d 0 }}{{ $f = append $f (printf "-%d" $d) }}{{ end }}{{ $p := list }}{{ if $f }}{{ $p = append $p (join " " $f) }}{{ end }}{{ if or (gt .Ahead 0) (gt .Behind 0) }}{{ $p = append $p (printf "+%d/-%d" .Ahead .Behind) }}{{ end }}{{ if or (gt $u 0) $p }}({{ if gt $u 0 }}<p:red>!{{ $u }}</>{{ if $f }} {{ else if $p }},{{ end }}{{ end }}{{ join "," $p }}){{ end }}{{ if gt .StashCount 0 }}<p:yellow>+</>{{ end }}{{ if gt .Working.Untracked 0 }}<p:yellow>*</>{{ end }}

{{ .Code }}{{ $m := dict "1" "error" "2" "usage" "126" "no perm" "127" "not found" "128" "bad exit" "130" "interrupted" "131" "quit" "137" "killed" "139" "segfault" "141" "pipe" "143" "terminated" }}{{ with get $m (toString .Code) }}({{ . }}){{ end }}

console_title_template: {{ if and .Root (eq .OS "windows") }}🛡️ {{ end }}{{ if .Segments.Session.SSHSession }}{{ splitList "." .HostName | first }}:{{ end }}{{ if .Segments.Contains "Git" }}{{ .Segments.Git.RepoName }}@{{ .Segments.Git.Ref }}{{ else if eq .OS "windows" }}{{ $p := regexSplit `[\\/]` .PWD -1 }}{{ if le (len $p) 3 }}{{ join `\` $p }}{{ else }}…\{{ join `\` (slice $p (sub (len $p) 2)) }}{{ end }}{{ else }}{{ .PWD }}{{ end }}
